body: We are confirming our corporate offsite for 12 rooms from July 18-20. Some executives may arrive around 11am, so early check-in would be helpful. Please place our VP in a quiet king room away from elevators if possible. We also need gluten-free breakfast for two attendees, a projector in the meeting room, airport transfer from MAD, and a company invoice.
Sales told client we will note early arrival request. Quiet king for VP should be prioritized but not yet locked.
Please remember the projector and the quiet room for our VP. The meeting starts at 2pm sharp.
The VP was promised a quiet king room, but was placed near the elevator, and the projector was not ready when the meeting started.
Hi, I booked a room via Booking.com for July 19-21. Could I get a free upgrade to a suite? I'd prefer a high-floor quiet room. I'll arrive by car around 3pm — do you have parking available?

I'm booking a 30-night stay starting July 22. Could I get a long-stay discount for the monthly rate? Also, I think I left a phone charger in my room during my last visit — can you check lost and found? And the air conditioning in my room isn't cooling, please fix it.
